scope: Original computeSeries/castPointScale plus actual d3-scale scalePoint, point/series style recipes, points mapping/createElement arguments and Point spring/clamp expressions. Synchronous hook shims and accessor probes do not model React lifecycle, SpringValues, animation, inherited-color math or D3 line drawing.

execution.defaults:
{
    layers: ['grid', 'axes', 'labels', 'lines', 'points', 'mesh'],
    interpolation: 'smooth',
    xPadding: 0.6,
    xOuterPadding: 0.5,
    yOuterPadding: 0.5,
    colors: { scheme: 'nivo' },
    lineWidth: 2,
    activeLineWidth: 4,
    inactiveLineWidth: 1,
    opacity: 1,
    activeOpacity: 1,
    inactiveOpacity: 0.3,
    startLabel: false,
    startLabelPadding: 16,
    startLabelTextColor: { from: 'color' },
    endLabel: true,
    endLabelPadding: 16,
    endLabelTextColor: { from: 'color' },
    pointSize: 6,
    activePointSize: 8,
    inactivePointSize: 4,
    pointColor: { from: 'serie.color' },
    pointBorderWidth: 0,
    activePointBorderWidth: 0,
    inactivePointBorderWidth: 0,
    pointBorderColor: { from: 'serie.color', modifiers: [['darker', 1.4]] },
    enableGridX: true,
    enableGridY: true,
    axisTop: {},
    axisRight: null,
    axisBottom: {},
    axisLeft: {},
    isInteractive: true,
    defaultActiveSerieIds: [],
    lineTooltip: LineTooltip,
    pointTooltip: PointTooltip,
    useMesh: false,
    debugMesh: false,
    role: 'img',
    renderWrapper: true,
}
execution.spring:
{
        x: point.x,
        y: point.y,
        radius: point.size / 2,
        color: point.color,
        borderWidth: point.borderWidth,
        config: springConfig,
        immediate: !animate,
    }

manualHookInputDiagnostic.scope: Hand-authored computed-series input that computeSeries never emits. The downstream hooks/creation mapping add no second null filter. Not a normal upstream pipeline result or an extra Rust role obligation.
